<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that forms a sulfonamide functional group and creates an S‑N bond. I will use benzenesulfonamide (c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N) as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["S-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
